title: Glacier Art Museum

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Interested in booking Glacier Art Museum for your event? Whether it’s a company meeting, workshop, rehearsal dinner, or a formal affair - Glacier Art Museum is happy to host in our beautiful turn of the century Carnegie Library building, grounds and facilities. Prices and party capacity vary based on which space is booked. By choosing Glacier Art Museum as your event rental location, you can be assured that proceeds from event rental fees go to supporting the local art community through educational family & all-ages programming, inclusive community events, and a diverse range of consistently updated art exhibitions. Please email info@glacierartmuseum.org with the following information below

blurb: Glacier Art Museum itself is housed in a stunning classical-revival-style building, originally erected as the town library in 1903. In addition to rotating exhibits, it has a special “Crown of the Continent” Gallery that features works from the permanent collection by well-known artists, including O.C.
